full_judgment: 3. The defendant No. 1 preferred an appeal being F.A. No. 2 of 1950, to the then High Court. Cross-objection was filed by the respondent but it was not pressed. Hence, it was rejected. The High Court having found no substance in the appeal dismissed the same with costs. On further appeal to the erstwhile Supreme Court of Pakistan against the decision of the High Court, the said Court allowed the appeal, set aside the judgment of the High Court and remanded the appeal to the High Court to dispose of the same, in accordance with directions given therein. After remand, the appeal came before a Division Bench consisting of Mr. Justice Salahuddin Ahmed and Mr. justice Abu Sadat Mohammad Sayem, as their Lordships then were.
